list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18. Names and descriptions are PlayStation's own words; every guide below is written for this guide in our own words.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it, and it is the last trophy you will get. Follow this guide's roadmap in order and it will come after A Long Road. Community estimates put the full run at around 200 hours, though that will vary with how much optional content you finish along the way.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the game's own completion checklist, tracked by PSN as a count to 100. Most guides call this the hardest trophy in the list. Rockstar has not published the full 100% checklist, so work through every visible trophy's target and the in-game completion stats: story, side strands, collectibles, activities and exploration. Treat this as the last gold before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — PSN tracks your count toward 250. Stunts are jumps, airtime, near-misses and other driving feats the game counts as you pull them off. Chain them during free roam and races; any stunt the game registers adds to the total. No published guide has listed exactly what counts as a stunt yet, so watch the in-game counter as you play.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — PSN tracks 9 activity types. The game's activities include fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling and racing; try one of each distinct activity the game offers and the trophy pops at the ninth type. The exact nine have not been pinned down in a single published list yet, so if you have tried everything you can find and it has not popped, look for an activity type you have not touched.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots on PSN's counter. This is the one trophy guides flag as possibly missable: the first meditation spot is Lucia's balcony, offered in Chapter 1, and it becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, with no mission replay to go back to it. Meditate on the balcony in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends, then find the other 17 spots as you explore Leonida. If you are already past Chapter 1 without meditating there, that spot is gone for this playthrough.
trophies.missable_note: The first meditation spot is Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1. It becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Meditate there before finishing the chapter, or the trophy is locked out for this playthrough.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. Use fast cars and open ground to break away, then lie low until the heat dies down.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. With your partner beside you, rob a shop, keep the wanted level, and immediately rob two more shops in a row. Plan a route past three shops close together and keep moving — if the wanted level clears between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode: activate it, then drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a busy fight, wait for enemies to cluster, then trigger it and work through them fast — headshots help you finish each one before the focus runs out.

trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. This is a hidden trophy tied to a single airport moment: leave the airport in an aircraft outside any scheduled flight or mission. No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so try taking off from VCIA in a plane on your own, outside a mission.
